description:
Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations.

Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom, we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.

As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.

The Team and Your Impact

We're looking for a Senior Research Engineer who has trained large language models with their own hands and built the systems that train them. You'll own our models end to end: training new ones from scratch, from the first batch of data to a model serving real traffic.

This role sits between research and systems. Some weeks you'll design experiments. Other weeks you'll rewrite distributed training code because the cluster doesn't behave the way the paper said it would. You'll set technical direction and work closely with our CTO.

What You Will Own

  • Train new models from scratch

  • Build and own the training stack: data collection and pre-processing, distributed pretraining, fine-tuning, and inference

  • Design, scale, and debug multi-node training across GPUs

  • Run rigorous experiments and turn the results into decisions

Who You Are

  • Hands-on experience training LLMs from scratch across the full stack, from data preparation to pretraining, fine-tuning and inference

  • Extensive programming experience with Python

  • Experience writing or extending distributed training code for multi-node, multi-GPU setups, not only running existing frameworks

  • Strong performance engineering skills: profiling, finding bottlenecks, and making training and inference faster

  • Deep knowledge of transformer architectures and how training choices affect model quality

  • The ability to work independently on open-ended problems

Nice to Have

  • A background in large-scale distributed systems or databases, such as storage engines, concurrency, or correctness at scale

  • Experience with reinforcement learning or RL-based post-training, such as RLHF

  • Experience with ML hardware beyond standard GPU clusters, such as custom accelerators or unusual network topologies

Why join us

  • A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

  • A competitive salary with additional perks.

  • Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture.

  • High ownership and real impact.

  • Open-source, engineering-driven culture.

  • Choose your own laptop equipment.

For US-based full-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy.


Qdrant is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist.

Come build with us!


For information on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our Recruitment Privacy Policy
